title: AI-Powered Universal Communication Platform: Breaking Down Barriers Through Collaborative Innovation
summary: The Scott-Morgan Foundation reports that its communication platform enabled Erin Taylor, who has ALS, to introduce Lenovo's CEO at Tech World.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The Scott-Morgan Foundation reports that its communication platform enabled Erin Taylor, who has ALS, to introduce Lenovo's CEO at Tech World. The chapter also describes an Austrian former parliamentarian and a father using related communication tools. Lasting restoration of independent communication remains unestablished.
purpose: Enable people with severe communication impairments to express themselves.
developer: The Scott-Morgan Foundation with Lenovo, ElevenLabs, D-ID, and IRISBOND
deployer: The Scott-Morgan Foundation and participating users
location: Demonstrations at Lenovo Tech World and the Austrian Parliament

ratings.reason: Erin Taylor reportedly used the system to introduce Lenovo’s CEO. Lasting restoration of independent communication remains unestablished.

ai_role.statement: Eye tracking, language-model prediction, personalized voice synthesis, and avatars combine to enable communication. Their individual contributions have not been separated.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 15: AI-Powered Universal Communication Platform: Breaking Down Barriers Through Collaborative Innovation

produced_by: The account does not separately establish the conditions responsible for the benefit.
must_hold: Eye-tracking input compatible with the participant's abilities
Personalized voice material and an integrated hardware/software platform

headline: AI voice tools help people with ALS communicate
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
